status: Authored and internally reviewed; mechanical and browser gates pass; native review pending
method: Compare the publishers' own structure and explanation sections. Editorial level tags are estimates, not an official JLPT syllabus. No publisher examples or audio are imported.

points.formation: Attributive verb/い-adjective clause + はずだ/です; noun + のはず; な-adjective + なはず. Negative/past propositions may precede はず; the expectation itself may be past はずだった. Not advice or obligation.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve the N4-mapped construction already taught in n4-u07 with an explicit schedule/record as its basis. A grounded expectation is not confirmation. Do not score はず versus に違いない as mutually exclusive when both can express a conviction.

points.formation: Plain verb/い-adjective + わけだ/です; な-adjective + なわけ. Noun + のわけ or であるわけ; というわけ offers an explicit conclusion. Bunpro lists noun の, while Sensei lists noun である: teach the shared clear clause forms and label both nominal variants, rather than inventing disagreement over meaning.
points.teachingChoice: Draw an explanation from supplied facts; the story must distinguish a conclusion from newly discovered confirmation. The wider わけ family (ではない/がない/にはいかない) is deferred to its own notes. A plain noun used as reason is not automatically this construction.

points.formation: Dictionary verb + べきだ/です; するべき and すべき both occur. Past judgment is べきだった, not past verb + べき. Negative recommendation is べきではない, not negative verb + べき. Noun/な-adjective + であるべき; formal い-adjective + くあるべき. Teach verb forms for scored tasks here.
points.teachingChoice: State speaker, listener and shared responsibility. Contrast an ethical/procedural recommendation with a predicted event, not a fabricated legal command. べき can sound strong; practice a self-directed/team statement and a softer alternative without claiming universal register equivalence.

points.formation: Plain verb/い-adjective clause or noun/な-adjective stem + に違いない/に違いありません. Do not add present copula だ before に. Past clauses retain past morphology where applicable. 違いない is not the verb negative 違わない.
points.teachingChoice: Use an original detective-style student-film prop puzzle as subjective conviction, not proof or an accusation against a real person. The subsequent record can confirm or disprove it. Avoid numeric confidence thresholds and cultural/personality stereotypes.
